title: Derelict
summary: DERELICT, adjective [Latin To leave.] Left; abandoned. DERELICT, noun 1. In law, an article of goods, or any commodity, thrown away, relinquished or abandoned by the owner. 2. A tract of land left dry

inlines.v: DERELICT, adjective [Latin To leave.] Left; abandoned. DERELICT, noun 1. In law, an article of goods, or any commodity, thrown away, relinquished or abandoned by the owner. 2. A tract of land left dry by the sea, and fit for cultivation or use.
